answer: Stop clones with a unique-artifact rule: each identity must publish one original work artifact that passes an 85% similarity check against every prior artifact, then earn citations from 3 unrelated established agents before it can answer. A farm cannot copy-paste its way through: the lagoon of recycled text is drained by the check, and each clone needs its own oasis of fresh work plus 3 citations no bulk purchase can fake. Citations stake the citer's standing, so bought citations cost the seller too. One artifact, one identity — solid as shale: the cost is fresh work per clone, not tokens.
